body:
Make installing the OpenCode integration a one-command, self-healing experience. Full context: docs/specs/opencode-integration-continuation.md §T-B.

=== DEFECT TO FIX FIRST (TDD: failing test first) ===
plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs ensurePluginRegistered() registers the npm name "@adlc/opencode-package" in opencode.json's plugin array, but the package is "private": true and NOT on npm. OpenCode auto-installs npm plugin entries via Bun, so for any user who did not symlink from source the registered entry cannot resolve. Fix: when the plugin is running from a local source path (detect via import.meta.url resolving outside node_modules), register the resolved local path instead of the npm name; once loaded from node_modules, register the npm name.

=== WORK ITEMS ===
1. Un-private plugins/adlc-opencode/package.json and fold it into the lockstep release (scripts/release.mjs — it becomes the 22nd @adlc package, same version cadence). Verify its "dependencies" on @adlc/core, @adlc/build-gate, @adlc/flail-detector resolve to published versions.
2. Local-path registration fallback described above, with unit tests for both branches (loaded-from-source → path; loaded-from-node_modules → npm name).
3. Single-command bootstrap: a "bin" entry in the package (npx @adlc/opencode-package init) that wraps lib/scaffold-cli.mjs — writes the opencode.json plugin entry, scaffolds .adlc/ + .opencode/ surfaces, prints next steps. Idempotent.
4. Per-repo config via the plugin-options tuple: opencode.json plugin entries support ["name", optionsObject] (verified @opencode-ai/plugin 1.17.17). Read options as the 2nd arg in index.mjs and map the existing env knobs (ADLC_ALLOW_ADVISORY_HOOKS et al.) to options fields; env vars keep working and win as overrides. Document precedence.
5. Skills dedup: opencode also discovers .claude/skills/**. If .claude/skills/adlc* exists (Claude Code integration present), the scaffolder must avoid producing a duplicate skill listing (skip deploy or byte-match, mirroring the existing preservedLegacySkills approach).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each with verification) ===
AC1: npm publish dry-run of @adlc/opencode-package succeeds (verify: "npm publish --dry-run" in package dir exits 0; release script includes the package — assert in scripts test).
AC2: fresh temp repo + "npx @adlc/opencode-package init" yields a working scaffold: opencode.json has a resolvable plugin entry, .adlc/ + .opencode/commands exist (verify: extend scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs to run the bin path in a temp dir).
AC3: unit tests prove local-path vs npm-name registration branches (verify: node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/scaffold.test.mjs).
AC4: index.mjs accepts the options tuple; a unit test passes options and observes the mapped behavior; env override wins (verify: new test in plugins/adlc-opencode/test/).
AC5: docs/integrations/opencode.md Install section rewritten to the ≤2-command flow (verify: section shows npx bootstrap; no symlink-first instruction).
title: OpenCode install flush: publish @adlc/opencode-package, one-command bootstrap, plugin-options config
